New horror film 'Werwulf' trailer released

The trailer for director Robert Eggers' new horror film, titled 'Werwulf', has been released. The film stars Aaron Taylor-Johnson, who is shown transforming into a creature in the trailer. The release of the trailer has generated attention among fans of the director and the horror genre.
